smoke.error: Vercel Blob: Failed to fetch blob: 403 Forbidden

cause: onboarding-session finds the Neon row then vacationEulaStatus reads the EULA Blob store. @vercel/blob get() returns null on 404 but throws on 403. Private stores hide missing or other-store pathnames as 403. VercelBlobStore.getJson let that throw become HTTP 400. activationStatusPersistent also listed every sessions/ blob and get() each one, so one unreadable object failed the whole GET. Token is present on Production and Preview; this is path/store-read handling, not a missing env name.
fix: Treat Blob GET 403/404 as missing; skip unreadable list items; look up EULA activation by the deterministic vacation-${token} session id instead of listing the store. Recreate the pending EULA session in the token's store on next GET. If PUT also 403s after this ships, that is a dashboard token/store rebind (BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN on timesyncher-vacation-staging Production and Preview must belong to the store that prefix timesyncher-eula is written to).
